verdicts.title: p-ADIC L-FUNCTIONS AND RATIONAL POINTS ON CM ELLIPTIC CURVES AT INERT PRIMES
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Abstract Let K be an imaginary quadratic field and 
$p\geq 5$
 a rational prime inert in K. For a 
$\mathbb {Q}$
 -curve E with complex multiplication by 
$\mathcal {O}_K$
 and good reduction at p, K. Rubin introduced a p-adic L-function 
$\mathscr {L}_{E}$
 which interpolates special values of L-functions of E twisted by anticyclotomic characters of K. In this paper, we prove a formula which links certain values of 
$\mathscr {L}_{E}$
 outside its defining range of interpolation with rational p
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns p-adic L-functions, CM elliptic curves, and rational points (Gross-Zagier/Kolyvagin p-converse), with no mention of resolution proof complexity, Tseitin formulas, or proof-length bounds. It shares only the broad vocabulary of 'L-functions' with the conjecture.
